name: Eleven
detailed_description:
🔹 Over 100 Million Ways To Customize Your Ship

Stand out in the void with a ship that matches your identity. ELEVEN lets you customize your thrusters, shields, ship body, laser style, and more. Go bold with neon glows, or keep it sleek with stealthy finishes.

While combat is purely competitive, expression is limitless. You earn respect through performance — but you earn style through choice.

🔹 Enjoy Fast Paced Head-to-Head Combat

The arenas in ELEVEN aren't just maps — they’re dynamic battlegrounds set in the depths of space. Navigate vertical zones, tight corridors, and wide-open kill boxes, all suspended in zero gravity.

Each arena is built for high-mobility, low-latency combat where the only limit is your reaction time. Master the layout, control the angles, and dominate the arena from every axis.

🔹 Cross-Platform For The Whole Family

Whether you're on PC or console, ELEVEN keeps everyone in the same arena. Jump into seamless matchmaking across platforms and compete with friends — or enemies — no matter where they play. The controls are tight, the performance is sharp, and the action is balanced for fair, skill-first fights across every device.

No matter how you play, you're always in the fight.

short_description: In Eleven, customize your ship with powerful lasers, adaptive shields, and precision thrusters. Choose colors, ships, and thrusters to match your style. Master zero-gravity mechanics and outmaneuver rivals in intense space battles where every choice matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6200U or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 or equivalent integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Playable on low settings with integrated graphics.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth high settings and fast load times.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Quad-Core) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Playable on older Intel Macs with low settings. Stable performance on base M1 chips.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or external
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on M-series chips at high settings.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6200U / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R7 / NVIDIA 960M
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Playable on Steam Deck with low settings. Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU and recent Mesa drivers.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 / Intel i5 9th Gen or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5600 / NVIDIA GTX 1660 or better
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or external
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Steam Deck and Proton. For best results, ensure GPU drivers are up to date.
